title: Mung Bean Sambhar
description: A traditional South Indian dish made with mung beans and spices. This recipe is a flavorful and nutritious option for a comforting meal.
instructions: Rinse the mung beans and soak them in water for at least 4 hours. Drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the ground cumin and coriander and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sambhar and vinegary to the pan and bring to a boil.
Add the mung beans to the pan and reduce heat to low.
Simmer the mixture for 20-25 minutes or until the mung beans are tender.
Add the cooked and mashed beans to the pan and stir well.
Season the sambhar with salt to taste.
Serve hot garnished with fresh cilantro.
Store leftover sambhar in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
